ModMetaData.name: 超维存储SuperDimensionalStorage
ModMetaData.author: 中津静流
ModMetaData.description:
本mod由AI辅助完成，是一类轻量化数字化存储mod，旨在尽可能贴近原版逻辑＋尽可能兼容更多mod＋方便存储。 作者深受存储类mod功能不足、功能冗余、bug较多、兼容性差等困扰，于是自学RimWorld mod制作；本mod也旨在解决这些痛点难点。
本mod设计理念为所有超维空间核心、超维空间锚点、携带超维空间芯片的殖民者、主人是携带超维空间芯片殖民者的机械体，皆共享一个超大容量的超维空间。 无需手动物化物体，原版所有机制均可看见超维空间库存，本mod解决了原版内容以及调用原版API第三方MOD对虚拟物资不可见的问题。
对部分第三方mod专门兼容清单——「Pick Up And Haul」＋「Combat Extended」＋「联合轻工家具拓展-UF Light Industries Furniture」＋「牵引光束搬运器Manipulator Beam Emitter」＋「米莉拉扩展-未来科技Milira Expanded - Future Technology」＋「天工模块化穿梭机 CeleTech Shuttle Extension」＋「ProjectE 等价交换」＋「VC载具框架VersatranZeroOne」。 兼容性申明——所有严格使用原版函数API的mod；所有非全自动的第三方mod工作台。本mod制定了公共API，允许第三方mod使用超维空间库存。
经过两轮重构，本mod收敛了原版“看的见”“读的准”“找得到”“拿得到”“存的到”这五条路径的逻辑链；按照原版函数的API进行补丁，与具体工作类型、具体工作台清单完全解耦。
欢迎各位积极反馈bug与未适配mod，反馈格式——请带上录屏/详细说明＋mod名称＋报错日志，发送至作者本人邮箱——sizuru12395@qq.com。翔实证据发送至邮箱，是本mod唯一官方快速反馈渠道。
感谢“PSIONIC海豹”提供的美术支持。 —————————————————————————————————————————————————————————— This mod was completed with AI assistance. It is a lightweight digital storage mod aimed at staying as close to vanilla logic as possible, being compatible with as many mods as possible, and making storage convenient. The author was troubled by storage mods’ insufficient features, redundant features, numerous bugs, and poor compatibility, so they taught themselves RimWorld modding; this mod is also intended to solve these pain points and difficulties.
The design philosophy of this mod is that all Hyperdimensional Space Cores, Hyperdimensional Space Anchors, colonists carrying a Hyperdimensional Space Chip, and mechanoids whose owner is a colonist carrying a Hyperdimensional Space Chip all share one ultra-large-capacity Hyperdimensional Space. There is no need to manually materialize objects; all vanilla mechanics can see the Hyperdimensional Space inventory. This mod solves the problem that vanilla content and third-party mods calling vanilla APIs cannot see virtual supplies.
Dedicated compatibility list for some third-party mods—「Pick Up And Haul」＋「Combat Extended」＋「联合轻工家具拓展-UF Light Industries Furniture」＋「牵引光束搬运器Manipulator Beam Emitter」＋「米莉拉扩展-未来科技Milira Expanded - Future Technology」＋「天工模块化穿梭机 CeleTech Shuttle Extension」＋「ProjectE 等价交换」＋「VC载具框架VersatranZeroOne」. Compatibility statement—all mods that strictly use vanilla function APIs; all non-fully-automatic third-party mod workbenches. This mod provides a public API that allows third-party mods to use the Hyperdimensional Space inventory.
After two rounds of refactoring, this mod has consolidated the logic chains of the five vanilla paths: “can be seen”, “read accurately”, “can be found”, “can be taken”, and “can be stored”; it patches according to the APIs of vanilla functions and is completely decoupled from specific work types and specific workbench lists.
Everyone is welcome to actively report bugs and unadapted mods. Feedback format—please include a screen recording/detailed description + mod name + error log, and send it to the author’s personal email—sizuru12395@qq.com. Sending detailed evidence to the email is the only official fast feedback channel for this mod.
Thanks to “PSIONIC海豹” for providing art support.
